title: release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad (2026-03-05)
content:
Quick notes / scratchpad for today's cutover (prod deploy v2026.03.05)

Context:
- Target: rolling deploy of serving-runtime + router config + optimize tweaks.
- Window: 02:00-04:00 PT (low traffic).
- Owners: Jordan (cutover lead), Samira (db/migrations), Ethan (obs + rollback), Priya (customer comms standby).

Checklist (pre-cutover) - to confirm before T-30: 
- [x] Final smoke test on staging (basic chat + embeddings) - OK, latency within SLOs.
- [x] All PRs merged to release branch (see PR #4789) - merged @01:05.
- [x] Release notes drafted in confluence (link above).
- [x] DB migration script reviewed - no destructive ops, but added index build deferred.
- [ ] Nightly backup completed (waiting for verification from infra).
- [ ] SRE on-call alerted and confirmed (pinged #sre-oncall).
- [ ] Pager duty rota checked for 04:00 - 10:00 (post-cutover coverage).

Backports / Hotfixes to prepare (if needed):
- REL-1234: backport rate-limiter fix -> branches: release/2026-03, hotfix/rlimit-2026. If rollback required, revert PR 4721 and push hotfix.
- PR 4710: small logging change - low-risk, not required for rollback but good to have.

Cutover timeline (rough):
- 01:30 PT - final pre-checks, start maintenance page stub (if needed).
- 01:45 PT - freeze non-essential deploys, lock CI for release branch.
- 02:00 PT - begin deploy: scheduler -> serving-runtime -> router config -> optimize configs.
  * Deploy order: infra (helm) -> runtime pods -> router -> canary traffic shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
- 02:30 PT - run fast end-to-end smoke (chat + long-context generation + embeddings).
- 03:00 PT - full traffic shift if smoke OK.
- 03:15-04:00 PT - live monitoring, soak.

Comms:
- Slack: announce start in #releases and #prod-alerts at 02:00 PT. Short status updates at each traffic shift.
- Email/stakeholders: summary sent by Priya after full traffic shift.
- Status page: set to "under maintenance" only if we expect visible user impact (likely not).

Rollback plan (fast path):
- Trigger if: error rate > 3% sustained for >5m OR latency P95 > 2x baseline for >10m.
- Steps:
  1) Shift traffic back to previous router config (Ethan) - should be immediate.
  2) Roll back deployment via helm rollback to previous release tag (Jordan/infra).
  3) If stateful issue: run DB rollback steps (Samira) - note: DB migrations are backwards-compatible; otherwise engage DB restore from snapshot.
  4) Post-mortem channel: create thread in #incident-postmortem and assign.

Post-cutover validation (T+15m, T+60m):
- T+15: end-to-end smoke (verify tokens, samples, embedding similarity quick check).
- T+60: run load script for 10m on canary to verify stability.
- T+120: verify billing/cost metrics - batch/kv cache behavior changed, watch token cost delta.

Open items / TODOs (notes to self):
- Verify infra backup finished and get confirmation (action: Jordan -> infra backup owner).
- Add runbook note about "router cache warm-up" observed in staging - might cause initial spike in latency.
- Confirm alert thresholds updated for P95 and error-rate for this release.
- Remind Priya to include "if rollback occurred" paragraph in stakeholder email template.

Concise checklist for live use (copy to top of channel message):
- Start deploy (02:00 PT) - Jordan
- Monitor canary metrics (every 5m) - Ethan
- Migration check (none blocking) - Samira
- Notify stakeholders on 100% shift - Priya
- If rollback, execute fast path and notify: "rolling back to release X"

Notes / friction points observed in staging run:
- Router cache cold-start: first few requests had ~200ms added - acceptable but note for ops tuning.
- Batching: change increased throughput but initial token cost spikes for short requests - keep an eye on /v1/generate metrics.

Small private TODOs (not crucial):
- Draft a quick post-cutover blurb for the weekly release notes.
- Add link to reproducer for the intermittent kv-cache key error (Samira has logs).

Questions I still have (callouts):
- Should we temporarily increase canary duration to 30m given the cache warm-up? (ask Ethan)
- Is there an approved escalation contact in APAC in case midnight issues hit them (notified via ops)?

End scratchpad. Will update as things happen.

-- Jordan
(quick timestamp: 2026-03-05 00:45 PT)
